reason: Expert identifies a known false alarm for a fan alarm caused by a sensor bug in specific firmware, and advises when dispatch is actually required.

knowledge.summary: Fan alarm on transmission units running software version 3.1 is a known false alarm caused by a sensor bug; do not dispatch unless chassis temperature rises.
knowledge.author: Erkki Expert
knowledge.details: Chassis temp 38 C is normal range; firmware version affected is 3.1.
